## Design

### 2026-10-15 – ok lots of stuff happened

**6h**

ok lots of stuff happened
first of all, im no longer making the project i set out to make, im making a DIFFERENT robot arm. the other one was based around normal servos and a 15mm suction cup but this one is based around micro servos and will have a claw and be less good at manipulating ping pong balls (although i might make a suction cup attachment latter that sounds cool).

the thing that really inspired me to do this was learning how capacitors work (can you tell im scatterbrained?) and subsequently realizing that i can generate a PWM signal to control a servo with a 555 timer and a pot, which subsequently gave me the manic impulse to build a robot arm that i can control with knobs and buttons, so here we are.
i spent like 2 hours in class trying to figure out the right capacitor size because i am very dumb, here is my incoherent ramblings:

![IMG_0194](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/8be0b114657ea38147a36810172047e17f02af576a45af6c93f5b61115539517.jpg)

![IMG_0196](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/9b3930c65e51c1aaafc60c4a8d7e1f3ef8e73487cc070cbb82a5bba0661067eb.jpg)

![IMG_0197](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/4f22e8d874cfd3ef40a181b934050043e24d7dd8c5b3362e58adbf5bac38c094.jpg)

![IMG_0198](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/b5aac6a8d82cbe2a7c38bfc26be9761d4c85c89efbb6ff662d072bbf8fea8e02.jpg)

![IMG_0199](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/3feb2cf8f4c8638a2fc4289c8397c8c080883a0aedf56a1c972f2fe7934cb8f7.jpg)

actually i think one of those is a really hard physics problem i was working on and one of them is a procedure for electroless plating vias. you get to try to guess which is which! did i already say that i was scatterbrained?

anyways then i got home and started making the actual cad. originally i was gonna use SG90 servos because honestly what else would i use, here is the model i made for that:

![ArmSG90](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/8defb55bf8aef71d4e8cb58343a6398931cb0baa145544275630cd9baf181645.png)

but then i remembered that i have these other weird micro servos i stole from the garbage, and decided to use those instead. they are A0090s and they are very very similar to SG90s but just a litle different. they also have this absolutely adorable itsy bitsy 4 arm horn that i just absolutely love (i have issues with the standard servo horns being so damn long that you have to clip them to fit them into anything). also, they only turn 160 degrees. why? no clue. guess we doing 4:9 now.

![ArmA0090](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/c13b00a0858ce6db5790a8025e6a05edad487ad285d28d5de2421c792766d403.png)

then i got started on the base. im not going to explain my plan yet because i dident get very far. why? GEARS. WHY ARE GEARS SO HARD. all i want is a 30 tooth inside gear and a 70 tooth ring gear how is it this complicated? i started in the obvious spot trying to get the plugins to work, but i can never get them to do what i want them to so after like 30 minutes of trying i was just like "fuck it, ill do it myself" so then i spent like 2 more hours learning about involute curves and pressure angles and weird ass approximations before giving up, thinking really, really, hard, and realizing that im a complete dumbass and the plugins were working the entire time. the worst part is, i dont even think this is the first time i have done this. i remember going through this exact same character arc and coming to the exact same conclusion but i guess i just have brain parasites and forgot?? i might be, no, I am completely stupid. but then i made them helical gears and everything was fine because helical gears are so damn cool :)

![ArmBaseGears](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/9888c855f8fe9c8d7e55cfa46d097a88cb352381d7688fd11bf52229a8d7ef97.png)

### 2026-10-16 – ok so i made the base, or well most of it at least

**2h**

ok so i made the base, or well most of it at least
its a kind of neat design. in the past when i made robot arms i just had like a big axle that would get held in place but that would bend and wobble and was just generally a point of failure, so instead i have a ring of little 3d printed rollers that act like a big thrust bearing. im a little worried that there will be to much friction but its probably fine. i also usually shy away from making overhanging parts in 3d printable designs, like as far as im concerned if you have a part that cant be defined by a depth map its not very 3d printable, but for the base plate i decided to break that rule because i dident want to try to mount the upper ring to the thin little legs and this is like the perfect spot for organic supports. anyway, here are some glamorous angles:

![ArmBase1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/2cd656ad9c5a96837dac591a11f4fd37f882412e822492f2086c84abb48e34a0.png)

![ArmBase2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/a265d03f7db7a256bb112ee85002e21d4f2e0118408c2cd6b9c8e4d08162c49c.png)

**2h**

Im not happy with it.

### 2026-10-16 – ok so, just after i wrote the last entry. im feeling sad because robot no work :( so i decide to look at cool robot arms to see if that makes me feel better.  and then i see it. the faunc M-800.

**2.5h**

ok so, just after i wrote the last entry. im feeling sad because robot no work :( so i decide to look at cool robot arms to see if that makes me feel better.  and then i see it. the faunc M-800.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/74aee75d54071b9827e4ca3c9d477c142771314880c2f3749a677edf05556c18.png)
something about the way the forearm goes to the side and the elbow join was made to sit behind the main platform just did it for me. I immediately took out a sheet of paper and started drawing, making good on the issue i identified in my last entry.

![ArmDrawing1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/34619149673119639da1e54e09b5d94d5c2eea7e7fdc495d98f4704d79254021.jpg)

but then i though for like 30 seconds and realized that it would look bad without a big boxie thing to counterbalance the offset shoulder joint, which encourages me move the electronics in there which encourages me to use a microcontroller which defeats the original motivation of having a bunch of 555 timers and pots controlling the servos and also is better suited for a different robot arm that i want to build (the one i initially set out to work on with this project but then got distracted maybe this is why i dont finish projects). so, i went back to the drawing board. the other thing i got from scrolling through robot porn on fauncs website was a realization that there are actually a lot of different subtle variations of the same general idea, which encouraged me to eventually draw this:

![ArmDrawing2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/6e730b5b3c7e5bb60333306b9f86ae3cb7d0ae8af25fd82a9b6867f94dbf109a.jpg)

![ArmDrawing3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/22b6407cc00ae4763ab90aa9d00b024395a911236346176f48a16e2e9b63a3e5.jpg)

the QT120. i absolutely love how it folds up nice and snug and one of the benefits of being trapped at prison for 7 hours a day is you get a lot of time with paper to think about how things are going to work before you even touch cad. also, i looked into the resin printer at my school, and it seems like it works! so that means that i can make smaller more precise parts (mainly not having to use the stupid default servo horns). there are definitely a few things that are sketch about the design, like the fact that i will have to use a bunch of rope to drive all the things in the tight spaces and also that i will have to castrate the servos to make things fit, but you know thats all just part of the challenge. its also only 4 axis which is kinda lame but like... where does the wrist go. anyway im super motivated now and im totally not going to be able to finish this in like 2 days but im gonna try my damn best.

### 2026-10-18 – I just realized how incredibly small this arm is. 120mm kinda seems like a lot because 120 big number right and it kinda looked like a lot because i was using a ruler and a rulers pretty big and its l

**5h**

I just realized how incredibly small this arm is. 120mm kinda seems like a lot because 120 big number right and it kinda looked like a lot because i was using a ruler and a rulers pretty big and its like an optical illusion and stuff but today i was designing the gripper and i was like "wow 30 mm of travel is a lot do i really need to be able to grab a Lego from the side?" and then i realized that i was talking about a FUCKING LEGO and 3 CM and started to question my life decisions. initially i was gonna make like a parallelogram gripper thing (you can see the plans in my drawings) but then last night at like 11:00 i struggled for 2 hours and realized that thats just like... not... not gonna work. its just to small. i was using like m2 screws and everything this robot is just tiny. where the servo gonna go? where the cable gonna go? where the spring gonna go? it just dont fit. so then i pondered for a wile and considered a bunch of things like solenoids and bell linkages and 0.2mm module gear rack (i was tired, ok) and then i want to sleep but then the next day i had a flash of inspiration. the other kind of parallel robot gripper robot gripper that looks like this

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/577bd11d89ae807d1fc55e006f994af1480a6cdb13fb129e93a324108772fa66.png)

and i had an idea. we are going to drive this with string anyway (if you think thats stupid, where you are gonna put a 32 mm servo in a 30mm claw?) so whats the point of converting translation back to rotation to drive translation again? basically we can just use a string and a rubber band and save myself a lot of headaches. to achieve the 32mm of grip size needed to grab a 2x4 Lego piece (kinda a soft goal i set for this robot) i can have the grippers offset and their pulling points on the far sides, allowing both sides to get almost the full 30mm of travel and making the max grip size like 40mm or something.

![ArmGrippers](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/59682aec06892a5dfc5ad20121f201b2c096df4c73ca35aaf88d9327a9d9e378.png)

then they can live in a little rack (with holes for the string)

![ArmGripperCase](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/09c490a1fc5e271427a67e27306c1345ae2883faeb9da14ee0f10a8429c0531d.png)

and thats a rough claw!

![ArmGripperFull](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/58eaf0ef90283aa02478ac44f94a540c913b534454f4cc8538ee6b7b718216be.png)

also i found this weird setting that makes everything stripy and i have no idea what it could be used for besides making it more difficult for German ships to determine your heading and direction

![ArmZebraStripes](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/SBJjSHTWe8hvDrkl8UXPZsu6tr233Wj5/0274525ff52546b3193c7747bf34a424e94022f27558cc8ce341ad7821171769.png)
